title: Seka Spear long-term review: ride experience
notes: Reviewer's article images (read from original pixels) state the official 685 g bare-frame claim and their own weigh-in of a size-M frame in 暗银 (dark silver): 835 g with paint and metal parts, fork 406 g and integrated bar 338 g. The ride report finds the frame very comfortable when seated, notes hand numbness from the fork and bar, and describes pedalling as less direct than stiffer race bikes, improving with different wheels. Personal segment times are ride impressions, not a controlled test.

capture.scope: Archived public post; text images were read from the original files, which remain outside Git. No image is republished.
